opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland and enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish higher education institution, and who are not eligible for government funding (SAAS) for their tuition fees. Includes students seeking asylum and, in limited cases, those pursuing a second degree in skills-shortage areas.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering tuition fees for undergraduate students from low-income Scottish households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, up to £1,820 per year.
